Our Story

A Legacy of Excellence

Founded in 2003, N.Y. General Renovation began with a simple mission: to provide New Yorkers with honest, quality renovation services that stand the test of time.

What started as a small family business has grown into one of New York`'s most trusted renovation companies, serving thousands of satisfied customers across all five boroughs and Long Island.

Today, we continue to uphold the same values that guided us from the start: exceptional craftsmanship, transparent communication, and unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction.
